app.title: Cosmere Trivia
app.tagline: How well do you know the Cosmere?

home.practiceDesc: Pick a world and a difficulty
home.newGameConfirm: Starting a new game will discard the game in progress. Continue?

level.title: Difficulty level
level.normalDesc: A mix of easy and medium questions, with a few hard ones.
level.expertDesc: Hard and expert questions only, for rereaders.

lifeline.title: Lifelines
lifeline.rules: Each player gets one of each per game (quick games too). They can’t be used on the final question or in practice, and Atium and Stormlight can’t be combined on the same question.

atium.name: Atium
atium.long: Burn atium and glimpse the future: two wrong answers are removed.

stormlight.name: Stormlight
stormlight.desc: Activate before answering: if you miss, choose again.
stormlight.long: Activate it before answering. If you pick a wrong answer, it is marked and you choose again; the right one isn’t revealed. The clock keeps running. If you use Breath while it’s active, it stays active on the new question.
stormlight.armed: Stormlight active: if you miss, you can choose again.
stormlight.saved: Stormlight heals you! Not that one: pick another answer.

breath.name: Breath
breath.desc: Swaps the question for another from the same world and difficulty.
breath.long: Swaps the question for another one from the same world and difficulty. If there’s none left, it can’t be used.
breath.none: No other question from the same world and difficulty.

lifeline.noCombo: Atium and Stormlight can’t be combined on the same question.

setup.title: New game
setup.timerHint: Running out of time counts as a wrong answer.

wheel.label: Category wheel
wheel.infusedPick: {category} is already infused: pick another world!

classic.alreadyInfused: {category} is already infused, so no extra charge.
classic.allInfused: All gems infused! Next up: the final question.
classic.finalFail: Not this time. You'll face the final question again on your next turn.
classic.finalIntro: {name}, all your gems are infused. Answer this question correctly to win!
classic.streakPass: {n} right in a row! The turn passes to {name}.

victory.title: {name} wins!
victory.subtitle: Every gem infused and the final question answered.

quick.title: Quick game
quick.quitConfirm: Quit this quick game? Your score will be lost.
quick.intro: {n} questions from every world, {s} seconds each. The faster you answer, the more points you score.
quick.introLifelines: You get one of each lifeline: Atium, Stormlight and Breath.

practice.title: Practice
practice.fallback: No {level} questions here yet: you’ll practice with {fallback} ones.
practice.noneFilter: No questions available: the spoiler filter leaves no works with questions. Select more works in Settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.spoilersHint: Tick the works you've read. Only questions about them will appear.
settings.resetConfirm: This deletes your stats, records, saved game and settings. Are you sure?
settings.storageWarning: Storage isn't available, so settings and progress won't be kept after closing the app.

about.title: About
about.body: A Trivial-style quiz about the worlds of Brandon Sanderson's Cosmere. Play solo or pass the phone around with friends.
about.rule1: Spin the wheel and answer a question about the world it lands on.
about.rule2: Right answer: you earn a charge in that world and spin again. Wrong answer: the turn passes to the next player.
about.rule3: Two charges infuse a gem. The wildcard lets you pick the world.
about.rule4: Infuse every gem, then answer the final question to win.
about.offline: Works offline once loaded. Everything is stored on this device only.
about.disclaimer: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Brandon Sanderson or Dragonsteel. The Cosmere and all related names belong to their respective owners.
about.levelsFinal: The classic game’s final question is medium on Easy, hard on Normal and expert on Hard and Expert.
about.rule5: A random draw decides who starts. After 3 right answers in a row, the turn passes to the next player anyway.

errors.load: Couldn't load the questions. Check your connection and reload.
errors.noQuestions: No questions available with your current spoiler filter.
errors.fallback: Questions aren't available in this language yet, so they're shown in English.

boot.title: Something went wrong
boot.body: The app couldn’t start. The saved data may be damaged: clearing it usually fixes this (you’ll lose the game in progress, your settings and stats).
